title: Technology retrofit → functional placement
summary: Work determines relevance; employer-specific historical tool matching is not required.
body:
Work determines relevance; employer-specific historical tool matching is not required.

No exhaustive technology questionnaire or repeated justification of permission.

For each tool, Jev receives target technology, original JD passage, workflow stages and proposed role.

Choices: FUNCTIONAL / MISPLACED / UNNECESSARY / UNCERTAIN.

No default FUNCTIONAL and no first-three-technologies shortcut.
